title: Digging for gold
content: Parliament passed the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, which put the extraction and management of minerals in the hands of the Central government. Many in Odisha, one of India’s most mineral-rich States, fear that the new law will impact the State’s fiscal health, while also disrupting the Centre-State relationship. Satyasundar Barik delves into the amendment’s far-reaching implications through the views of multiple stakeholders

title: Two inmates arrested under POCSO Act escape from Srinagar Central Jail; search launched

title: Amid protests, TN CM Vijay drops project for 2nd airport for Chennai at Parandur
content: The proposed Parandur airport project has been officially dropped by the Tamil Nadu government. Chennai airport will now undergo expansion on its north-west side with a new terminal. This expansion aims to handle twenty million additional passengers annually. The fareless travel scheme for women will also be expanded to all government buses. New sites for airport development are currently under consideration and will be finalized soon.

title: Delhi-NCR sees heavy rain, thunderstorms; traffic snarls, waterlogging reported
content: On Monday, Delhi-NCR was hit by intense rainfall that led to severe traffic disruptions and widespread waterlogging across the region. The meteorological department issued a red alert for heavy downpours and a yellow alert for moderate rainfall. Thunderstorms and gusty winds were expected in various parts of the capital, which recorded a low of 27.8 degrees Celsius at Safdarjung station.

title: Pant surpasses Dhoni, becomes first India wicketkeeper to achieve this feat
content: Rishabh Pant has etched his name in Indian cricket history by surpassing MS Dhoni as the leading run-scorer for Indian wicketkeepers in away Tests. Achieving this remarkable milestone in a gripping match, Pant maintained an impressive batting average. Notably, he showed remarkable fortitude after an injury concern, returning to reinforce India's efforts with a key partnership.

title: Sam Altman admits he was ‘very wrong’ on OpenAI’s AI timeline after GPT-4
content: Sam Altman has admitted he misjudged how fast AI would reshape the economy, telling David Senra's podcast he expected far more disruption soon after GPT-4 arrived in 2023. The OpenAI chief blamed economic inertia rather than the technology, saying people keep using the same tools and buying from the same companies. His concession that everyone has been "too ambitious on timelines" follows his own AGI forecast slipping to 2030.

title: Beggar woman dies; Rs 8.40 lakh in savings, including coins
content: A beggar woman named Noor, aged 69, passed away in Mandya. Surprisingly, she had amassed significant savings of Rs 8.40 lakh over the years, consisting of coins collected in bags and funds held in her bank account. Local residents and family members honored her memory by performing her final rites, highlighting the hidden resilience and life story behind her humble existence.

title: Stamping of boarding passes for immigration clearance to be discontinued from Sept 1
content: From September 1, international travelers departing from India are set to benefit from a new policy that eliminates the necessity for boarding pass stamping at immigration counters. This initiative aims to enhance the efficiency of the travel process. Passengers have the option to present their boarding passes, either in electronic format or as a printed copy.

title: ‘This India will fight and reply’: Jaiswal's comment goes viral after Fernando spat
content: Yashasvi Jaiswal took to social media to address a recent video highlighting his confrontation with Fernando. He emphasised the importance of understanding the entire dialogue before forming opinions. The tension arose when the Indian opener was dismissed, leading to an exchange of words and a brief scuffle that required intervention. India's batting coach later remarked that Jaiswal should have kept a respectful distance from the bowler.

title: Mexico brings back 47 bison as ecosystem slowly begins to recover
content: After an absence of 160 years, American bison have made a remarkable comeback to Coahuila, Mexico. These majestic animals have become vital ecosystem engineers, actively rejuvenating worn-out landscapes. Their presence enhances soil quality and promotes water absorption in the dry terrain. Additionally, this return facilitates the resurgence of native predators and other wildlife, reflecting a wider initiative aimed at restoring vital species throughout North America.

title: Chinese humanoid robots beat Bolt's 100m time and human high-jump mark
content: At the recent Beijing Robot Games, humanoid robots set remarkable new benchmarks in speed and agility. One robot sprinted 100 meters in an astonishing 9.39 seconds, shattering Usain Bolt's record. Another demonstrated incredible prowess with a standing high jump of 2.88 meters, surpassing human limits. These milestones reflect China's advancements in the robotics field, yet experts caution that widespread adoption remains a future prospect.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years
content: The Primary School, founded by Priscilla Chan, has closed after a decade of operation.  Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, leading to the board's decision.  Academic results fell short of state benchmarks and leadership expectations.  Around 540 students will now join the Ravenswood City Elementary School District.  The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative provided financial support for the transition and student savings.

title: Video: After Dombivli, another doctor assaulted in Kalyan
content: A doctor faced alleged assault by a patient's son at a private hospital in Kalyan.  The incident occurred late Saturday night, causing panic among other patients present.  Police initially registered a non-cognisable complaint, which was later upgraded to an FIR.  This event follows a similar assault on doctors in Dombivli weeks prior.  Doctors are demanding strict action to ensure their safety and prevent future occurrences.

title: 20-year-old student finds 1,200-year-old gold 90 minutes into her first dig
content: In an exciting turn of events, an American archaeology student has stumbled upon a ninth-century gold artifact in Northumberland during her very first excavation. This intricately designed piece, likely serving a ceremonial purpose, was found close to Dere Street, linking it to the historical narratives of Roman and early medieval Britain.

title: Tom Brady’s Raiders role questioned as analyst raises commitment concerns
content: Tom Brady’s role as a Las Vegas Raiders minority owner is facing renewed scrutiny ahead of the 2026 NFL season. After the team’s disastrous 3-14 campaign, coaching changes and front office shake-up, NFL analyst Mike Florio has questioned whether Brady can truly help turn the franchise around while also working as FOX’s lead analyst. The conflict surrounding his dual roles could become an even bigger issue as the Raiders enter a crucial new season.

title: Gold price prediction today: Worst of gold price dips over?
content: Gold price prediction today: Looking ahead, market participants will closely monitor further developments in US Treasury operations, fiscal policy discussions, and upcoming economic data releases, which are expected to remain key drivers for gold prices in the near term.

title: 52 hospitalised after chlorine leak at Godhani water plant in Nagpur
content: A chlorine gas incident at the Godhani water facility led to the hospitalization of fifty-two individuals, with twelve later discharged following treatment for breathing issues. Emergency response teams from OCW, NDRF, and NMC promptly addressed the leak, which stemmed from an outdated chlorine tank. Authorities are now investigating the circumstances surrounding this alarming situation.

title: River in spate, Madhya Pradesh teachers on tubes to beat e-attendance clock
content: Teachers in the flood-prone region of Bhind, Madhya Pradesh, embark on a daily adventure as they navigate the surging Baisali river in inflated tubes. Their commitment to reaching remote schools on time is fueled by the stringent requirements of an e-attendance application. The heavy monsoon rains transform the journey into a perilous crossing, highlighting their dedication to education amidst adversity.

title: Woman stabs husband, tries to bag his intestines, jumps off roof as landlord walks in
content: A 40-year-old man was allegedly killed by his wife in a knife attack. The woman then jumped from the rooftop and sustained injuries. Police recovered three knives and collected forensic evidence from the scene. The deceased suffered severe abdominal injuries, with organs protruding from his body. The wife is in custody and receiving treatment for her injuries.

title: Bags ripped open, belongings missing: American Airlines told to pay Rs 3.61 lakh
content: A Delhi consumer commission ordered American Airlines to pay Rs 3.61 lakh.  Two passengers reported damaged bags and missing items upon arrival in Toronto.  The airline was found responsible for the baggage during the Miami to Toronto flight.  Compensation includes Rs 1.11 lakh for lost items and Rs 2 lakh for distress.  The commission dismissed complaints against British Airways and the insurer.

title: Amravati hospital NICU fire: CM Fadnavis orders high-level inquiry after 3 newborns die
content: Three newborns died after a fire broke out in Amravati District Women's Hospital's NICU. The blaze reportedly started following an explosion in a ventilator on the hospital's third floor. Doctors and staff quickly evacuated thirty-nine newborns from the intensive care unit. Six critically ill infants were transferred to a super-speciality hospital for care. The exact cause of the ventilator explosion and subsequent fire is still under investigation.

title: The 450km kill shot: How AIM-424 Malice is pushing air combat into a new era
content: The United States Navy has revealed its new AIM-424 LRAAM missile. This advanced weapon is designed for future aerial combat engagements. It will arm current and upcoming fighter jet models. The missile boasts an impressive range exceeding two hundred fifty nautical miles. This development aims to maintain American dominance in air warfare.

title: Another nightclub incident hits England: Fast bowler handcuffed, detained by police
content: Videos circulating on social media appeared to show Carse being led away from a club in handcuffs by four police officers. Carse, who is part of England's squad for the second Test against Pakistan, was seen outside a nightclub in Derby.

title: 140 years after Dick Barlow, Shoriful Islam achieves rare feat against Australia
content: The 25-year-old pacer from Panchagarh returned figures of 7/48 from 15 overs as Bangladesh bowled Australia out for 210 in their first innings at the Great Barrier Reef Arena.

title: What’s in the Imran Khan letter? Gavaskar, Kapil make three requests to Pakistan PM
content: The letter was initiated by former Australia captain Greg Chappell. It is the second appeal by former international captains seeking humane treatment and medical care for the 73-year-old Khan.

title: UEFA chief Ceferin rules out FIFA bid, but warns Infantino: ‘Quit or face rival’
content: UEFA president Aleksander Ceferin will not challenge Gianni Infantino for FIFA president.  Infantino faces a potential challenger in next year's FIFA presidential election.  This comes after Infantino's abandoned plan to sell FIFA competition rights.  Ceferin believes Infantino lacks broad support from the football community.  He also reminded Infantino of UEFA's past support for his rise.

title: Traitors 2: Parul accused of cheating; Krystal & Shahneel make serious claims
content: Parul Gulati's eviction from The Traitors has stirred up a whirlwind of controversy. Fellow contestants Krystal D'Souza and Shahneel Gill have boldly claimed that she received external game information. They argue that this advantage explains her uncanny ability to identify traitors. Such allegations raise serious questions about the fairness of the competition, ultimately tarnishing the integrity of the show and its participants.

title: 'Mahabharat' & 'Bazigar' actor, mimickry artist Aasha Singh Jaiswal passes away
content: Aasha Singh Jaiswal, a beloved veteran actor and skilled mimicry artist, passed away in Mumbai on August 22. Known for her substantial contributions to film and television, she was fondly remembered as an 'Iron Lady' by her son, Akkash Bharadwaj, on social media. Her remarkable legacy will undoubtedly continue to shine through her diverse body of work.

title: Ranveer submits defence against Farhan's Rs 45 cr claim, warns IMPPA to not intervene

They assert that the association lacks the authority to adjudicate this matter. Meanwhile, Excel Entertainment is pursuing compensation for Singh's withdrawal from the project. His legal team has indicated potential legal measures should the association rule unfavorably. Currently, the association's lawyers are scrutinizing the situation.

title: 'Awarapan 2' film nears Rs 140 crore net collection in India

The film made a strong opening with Rs 22 crore and achieved a remarkable first-week collection of Rs 113.50 crore. Following a successful second weekend, its domestic net collection grew to Rs 127.50 crore and the worldwide gross soared to Rs 193.00 crore.

title: School holiday August 24: Check state-wise school closure updates amid heavy rain
content: Heavy rainfall is affecting several parts of India on August 24, 2026, with the IMD forecasting heavy to very heavy rain in parts of Odisha and rainfall in Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand, West Bengal, Sikkim and other regions. There is no nationwide school holiday, but some Odisha districts have announced closures following adverse weather conditions. Parents and students should check district administration and school notifications before travelling.

title: Rupee climbs to 95.64 against US dollar; Iran sanctions, crude prices in focus
content: The rupee began the trading day on a stronger note against the US dollar, appreciating by seven paise to 95.64. Nonetheless, concerns over geopolitical tensions and steady demand from importers curbed significant gains. Compounded by elevated Brent crude prices, the rupee traded cautiously. Investors are particularly attentive to anticipated sanctions impacting Iran's oil sector. Notably, India's foreign exchange reserves saw a remarkable rise in the latest reporting week.

title: Man paid for Israel job, got no employment; consumer panel orders Rs 2 lakh compensation
content: A Kerala consumer commission ordered a refund of Rs 3.7 lakh and Rs 2 lakh compensation. Two individuals promised employment in Israel and took the money. Repeated postponements and fake travel documents constituted unfair trade practice. The commission noted the lack of evidence for genuine arrangements. The accused failed to appear and contest the complaint.

title: Jaish-e-Mohammed’s Pak HQ, razed in Op Sindoor, up and running
content: Fresh footage indicates it is fully operational again, complete with reconstructed domes, updated interior plastering, new paint, and premium marble flooring that conceals previous blast damage. Deep blast zones within the primary hall were filled with concrete, while ruined satellite buildings—including the Al-Sabir seminary and housing units for leadership—were demolished to enable new construction.

title: 2 Delhi MLAs among several injured after car jumps divider, slams into SUV

Anil Jha and Abhay Patil sustained minor injuries in the accident near the PWD office. Both MLAs were promptly shifted to LNJP Hospital for medical observation. The collision caused significant damage and required the Fire Brigade's assistance.

title: ‘Economic D-Day’: US ‘enters endgame’ against Iran; Tehran threatens Gulf oil blockade

In response, Iran has signaled a potential halt to oil exports from the Persian Gulf. Meanwhile, China has resisted US influence and advocates for diplomatic efforts. While attempts to rekindle negotiations are underway, the prevailing tensions pose significant challenges.

title: SIR ordeal: ‘Was envoy for India in 3 countries, but tough to prove citizenship’
content: Based in Punjab with journalistic experience of over two decades, Navjeevan Gopal is a senior journalist reporting on crucial issues such as drugs, crime, gangsters, terror and other security issues in the border state. The Punjab Police is one of his core beats. Currently an assistant editor with The Times of India in Punjab Bureau, he comes with a vast experience of over 18 years in The Indian Express, the national daily known for its investigative journalism. Gopal had started his career in journalism with the Hindustan Times as a contributor, gradually moving to The Indian Express and thereafter TOI. He also covers Punjab’s politics with his area of interests being the 104-year-old party Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He also extensively reported on Sikh diaspora settled across the globe.

title: Scotland recycles 72,000 contaminated single-use plastic bottles in a world-first move
content: a new recycling system has already processed 72,000 contaminated plastic sample bottles . the technology is now being expanded to petri dishes and pipette tips . Scottish Water is the first utility in the world to adopt GENERATIONS technology .

title: Three LPG cylinders, free bus travel for women - what CM Vijay announced in TN assembly
content: TN CM Vijay announces 3 free LPG cylinders, expands free bus travel scheme for women . the amount for the cylinder will be credited directly to the bank accounts of eligible beneficiaries . under the cooking gas scheme, women will be allowed to travel free of charge on government buses operating in metropolitan and urban areas .

title: Pay €25,000 for visa: Indian firm under probe after Spain's Algerian migration crisis
content: spanish investigators are examining whether visa appointment and document-processing companies helped a network prioritise applicants who paid bribes . the network allegedly charged applicants up to €25,000 per family to secure visas and residence or work permits .

title: Israel accuses Gaza of launching balloons and kites; responds with airstrikes
content: a four-year-old boy among 2 killed in two airstrikes in the Gaza Strip . at least two people, including a boy, were killed and seven others wounded . this comes as Israel threatens to intensify attacks following launches of balloons, drones and kites .

title: ‘10 cr Indians could lose right to vote’: Chidambaram after ex-envoy’s SIR post
content: ex-diplomat Navdeep Suri detailed difficulties he faced establishing his citizenship during the exercise in Punjab . he questioned what the experience of a common citizen might be if he himself faced difficulties despite having represented the country in three nations . suri said his detainment could leave 10% of the eligible population without the right to vote .

title: After CJP’s drive, Rajasthan unveils Rs 12,500cr school revamp plan
content: JAIPUR: govt has unveiled a three-year, Rs 12,500-crore roadmap for strengthening school infrastructure . announcement comes after a week of opposition and public outcry over restrictions on visiting and filming schools . Ranka alleges 'planned' attack, claims assailants met BJP MLA before assault .

title: 'Nation doesn’t have high expectations of you': UP CM Yogi slams Rahul over 'Manusmriti' remarks
content: CM Yogi slams Rahul Gandhi over his remarks on the Manusmriti . he also targets the party's state leadership over its alleged conduct in ayodhya . the party has a responsibility to uphold the Constitution and respect India's traditions .

title: 'Evicted at dead of night': Mahua Moitra moves SC over Nadia Circuit House eviction
content: the matter was mentioned before Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana . Moitra told the Supreme Court that local officials evicted her from her constituency accommodation in the middle of the night .

title: 'They can have their fantasies': Congress on TVK projecting TN CM Vijay as next PM
content: televisionK supporters are projecting a role in national politics . the actor-turned-politician said his leadership could have national ambitions . but the numbers in Parliament would ultimately determine who could become Prime Minister . he said the number in parliament would determine who would become prime minister .

title: ‘CTA intentionally prevented’: PTI alleges negligence over Imran Khan’s hospital visit
content: imran Khan's medical care under scrutiny in state-run hospital . the 73-year-old is accused of failing to provide a diagnostic test despite cardiologists warning of potential cardiac complications . a CT Coronary Angiography (CTA) scheduled for Khan was not conducted .

title: 'Killed Nijjar for drug trafficking': Goldy Brar in leaked audio
content: goldy Brar has admitted to orchestrating the murder of a pro-Khalistan terrorist . he said he was targeted over his "involvement in drug trafficking and promoting drug abuse" he is wanted in india for several killings, including that of singer sidhu Moosewala .
